thread:
Sasha K.: hey folks — can someone take a quick look at PR #2209? small change to the KV eviction heuristic + routing policy. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/runtime/pull/2209

Sasha K.: TL;DR: tweaks eviction threshold per-shard, adds a small LRU window, and a short-seq fast-path. local smoke: ~6% tail latency win on 128-token median traces and ~3% cost reduction on sampled production traces. planning to roll tomorrow morning if no blockers. looking for perf/sre + runtime eyes.

Jin Park: pinging @Leah O'Connor for perf numbers. also how does this interact with auto-batcher?

Leah O'Connor: I can take a look later today. Quick Q: does this change KV cache compatibility between model variants?

Sasha K.: no schema change — heuristic-only. cache metadata untouched. added feature flag `kv_evict_v2` so we can rollback.

Ron P.: left one comment on a boundary condition in the eviction loop (off-by-one on shard size). aside from that looks straightforward. did you run a canary?

Sasha K.: ran a 2h canary on the canary pool. no errors surfaced from runtime; we did see one transient OOM but traced it to an unrelated batch job on the same host.

Mina Gomez: can we attach a perf test to the PR? even a small bench in infra perf harness would help for approvals.

Sasha K.: added perf harness snippet and uploaded raw traces to the PR. snippet in the description:

```
# perf harness
python bench/kv_evict_bench.py --model redwood-7b --seqs 16,32,128 --iters 100
```

Jin Park: tiny nit — rename the log metric from `evict_count_v2` to `kv_evict.count` to match the rest of the metrics, otherwise :+1:.

Leah O'Connor: left two comments about routing fallback. If primary shard is saturated we should prefer local quantized fallback rather than doing a cross-region hop. Can you add that check or a guard?

Ron P.: once the boundary nit is fixed and Leah's fallback is addressed I'm happy to approve.

Mina Gomez: perf will approve once CI perf job/bench is green and traces are attached — sounds good otherwise.

Sasha K.: thanks — I'll address Leah's fallback change and fix Ron's off-by-one. will hold merge until perf green and Ron approves. planning to push changes in ~2 hours.

perf-bot: CI perf job queued for PR #2209. bench run id: perf-2026-03-17-42.

Leah O'Connor: sounds good, thanks for adding the flag — that makes rollback safe. i'll re-check after your push.

Jin Park: thx — if you want a faster rollout we can do a 2-hour canary with the flag off by default.

Sasha K.: noted. thanks all for the quick reviews.
